personality_one_liner: A premium, spacious, and elegant translation tool blending modern Luxe aesthetics with warm Maghrebi cultural undertones.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing to reflect premium feel. Never cramp elements.

do's: Language selector bar sticky at top
Featured/Hero elements on Premium paywall screen
dont's: Do not use on regular input fields or result cards

screens.name: Translate (Accueil)
screens.purpose: The core translation hub allowing text and voice input with side-by-side language swapping.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders matching the shape of the result card.
states.empty: A spacious, welcoming empty state showing a soft illustration or simply the blank input field ready for text.
states.error: Soft red warning toast indicating translation failure.

screens.layout: 1. Header: 'MaghrebTalk' in Playfair Display (brandPrimary) + soft gold chip showing '3/3 gratuites'. 2. Sticky Glassmorphism Language Selector: 'Français' on left, swap arrow in center, 'Marocain' on right. 3. Input Card: Large surfaceSecondary card with no borders, lots of padding (xl). A floating microphone FAB (brandTertiary with brandPrimary icon) tucked in the bottom right corner of the card. 4. Primary CTA: 'Traduire' button spanning full width minus padding. 5. Result Card: Same width, surfaceSecondary, displaying translation + phonetic + action row (Volume, Copy, Star). Background: An absolute positioned repeating geometric SVG pattern (or image) at 3-5% opacity.

screens.name: History & Favorites
screens.purpose: Easily access past translations and saved favorite expressions.

states.empty: Elegant empty state icon (Feather bookmark/clock) with Playfair Display heading 'Aucun favori pour le moment'.

screens.layout: Standard vertical list. Each row is a surfaceSecondary card (radius md) showing source language on top (small text) and Maghrebi translation below (large text, Playfair Display), with a star icon aligned to the right. Use subtle divider lines between items.

screens.name: Premium Paywall
screens.purpose: Convert free users to the unlimited plan by highlighting exclusive features in a luxurious dark-mode environment.
screens.layout: Dark theme override for this screen only. Background uses the dark green/gold abstract image with a heavy linear-gradient scrim (top to bottom). Large golden typography. A feature list with gold checkmarks. A large 'S\'abonner - Illimité' CTA (brandSecondary). A subtle 'Continuer avec Google' secondary button.

background_pattern.alt: Subtle light beige texture to be used at very low opacity (5%) for geometric background feel

premium_hero.alt: Dark green and gold elegant abstract background for the premium screen

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The background MUST be a warm cream/beige (#FDFBF7), NEVER pure white (#FFFFFF).
NO TOLERANCE: Absolutely no blue or indigo colors anywhere in the app. Use the defined palette.

BACKGROUND TEXTURE: Apply the 'background_pattern' image or a CSS/SVG geometric pattern absolutely positioned at the root of the app with opacity between 3% and 5% to give it a subtle Maghrebi texture without visual clutter.
TYPOGRAPHY: Ensure 'Playfair Display' (serif) is used for headings and the logo, and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' (sans-serif) for all body text, UI elements, and buttons. Do NOT use Inter or Roboto.

PREMIUM SCREEN: The Premium Paywall screen should feel extremely luxurious. Use the 'premium_hero' image as a background with a strong gradient scrim (transparent to #1A4D2E) overlaid, so the gold/white text pops perfectly.
LANGUAGE SELECTOR: Use a glassmorphism (expo-blur) container for the sticky language selector at the top. Ensure it stays anchored during scroll.
FLAGS: Do NOT use emojis for flags. Instead, use clean text abbreviations (FR, MA, DZ, TN) inside a rounded brandTertiary chip, which looks much more premium.
HAPTICS: Add subtle haptic feedback when swapping languages, tapping the microphone, and favoriting a translation.
Ensure safe area is respected, especially for the absolute positioned background texture so it doesn't bleed weirdly over safe area edges.
